review.boundary_review: The target page is the left leaf (approximately x 265–3135). Content beyond the gutter, from about x 3135 onward (ticks, a 't' mark, an arrow and shelfmarks b.94, b.99, d.507, d.635, f.44, d.591 ...), belongs to fol. 42 and is correctly excluded. The opening 'followed by' lines continue fol. 41's last holding by probable inference only. The fol. 42 image shows this page's 'Abhimanyu-vivāha' and ': D.' at its left edge, so there is no extra text there.

region_review.top: Contains the page label '41b', a tiny stroke near the top centre (approximately 1995,400) and a faint speck. There is no other text.
region_review.middle: Below r004 the ruled lines are empty. There is only faint mirror-image show-through from the reverse and a short dash at approximately (1715,1810). No written entries were found.
region_review.bottom: Shows only show-through and ink specks: a dot at approximately (510,3548), dots at approximately (1095–1210,4713), and further dots at approximately (2069,4731) and (2754,4745). No bottom note was found.
region_review.left_margin: The shelfmark column holds only 'd. 368(4)'. No marginal notes or ticks are present.
region_review.right_margin: The date/extent column has 'n.d.:7:10:D.' for r004. 'vivāha.' wraps below b003 at the right. The facing-page material beyond the gutter is excluded.
region_review.interlinear: Two interlinear features: the superscript '(1)' in b003 and '?ī' above 'Guptavat-' in b004. There are no other insertions or cancellations.
